title: Two-dataset CITE-seq calibration and locked-holdout evaluation of conservative PBMC lineage acceptance
claim_target: A context-specific candidate gate can enrich correctness of coarse RNA-derived PBMC lineage labels when evaluated against paired orthogonal ADT anchors in a distinct public dataset.

input_gates.rna: full matrix must be finite, nonnegative integer counts
input_gates.adt: protein_expression must be finite, nonnegative integer counts with protein_names metadata

orthogonal_anchor_rule.ambiguous_cells: excluded from endpoint evaluation and counted explicitly

rna_candidate_rule.normalization: per-cell counts per 10000 followed by log1p
rna_candidate_rule.label: highest mean expression across fixed lineage marker module
rna_candidate_rule.confidence_score: top module mean minus runner-up module mean

candidate_gate_fit.selection_rule: lowest observed confidence threshold with at least 100 accepted cells and Wilson 95% precision lower bound >= 0.90; ties choose higher coverage
candidate_gate_fit.fallback: if no threshold qualifies, produce a negative result and no candidate profile

activation_requires: cryptographic binding to final released artifact
